_comment: Canonical HMAC vectors for the download-proxy signature scheme (mcp_data_core.mcp.downloads.sign_path). The Cloudflare Worker in patent-client-agents-deploy ports this scheme to Web Crypto and MUST reproduce these signatures exactly. If this file changes, copy it to the Worker's test fixtures and re-run both suites. sig = urlsafe_b64(HMAC_SHA256(secret, f'{path}|{bucket}')[:9]).rstrip('=').
